observations: a01 and a03 are each closed 10-point loops in the 0-100 coordinate space; a03 encloses a01 with shared vertex order.
a09 is a 10-point polyline spanning x=10 to x=91 with moderate vertical oscillation.
a07 is a 10-point polyline spanning x=10 to x=91 with stronger vertical zigzag, crossing a09's range.
INPUT.json lists 8 directed connections between asset IDs; none were used to build the trace.
interpretation: The two nested loops read as concentric rings around a common center, and a09 reads as a smooth oscillating wave. I treated the loops as a ring system and a09 as a flowing band rather than as static point lists.
new_relation_or_transformation: A new ring was derived from a01 by scaling it 1.35x about its centroid and rotating it 18 degrees, placed between the a01 and a03 rings. a09 was mirrored about y=45 and the two copies joined into a single filled wave band. a07 was kept as a contrasting zigzag thread over the band.
possible_dependence_on_input: The composition's geometry is fully determined by the supplied coordinates of a01, a03, a07 and a09; only scaling, rotation and mirroring were added by me.
limitations: The trace is an aesthetic transformation of the supplied data only; it does not demonstrate causation or any property of the underlying source items, and the unused connections may or may not be relevant.
